$comment: What each input type, entity type and category means, in plain words. Served by the registry API (/v1/types) and ot mcp (list_types). Every value in spec/schema/v1.json's inputType, entityType and category enums needs an entry; tests check it.

inputs.email: An email address, such as jane@example.com
inputs.username: A handle or account name on a website, without the @
inputs.phone: A phone number, best in international form such as +14155550100
inputs.domain: A domain or host name, such as example.com or mail.example.com
inputs.url: A full web address, including https://
inputs.name: A person's full name
inputs.image: An image: a URL to one, or a path to a file
inputs.crypto_address: A cryptocurrency wallet address (Bitcoin, Ethereum and others)
inputs.hash: A file or password hash (MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 and others)
inputs.string: Free text, as the tool describes
inputs.integer: A whole number, such as a limit or a timeout
inputs.enum: One of a fixed list of values, given by the tool

entities.account: An account on a website or service, usually with its site, username and URL
entities.subdomain: A host name under a domain, such as mail.example.com
entities.person: A person, by name or profile
entities.organization: A company, group or other organisation
entities.location: A place: an address, a city, or coordinates
entities.breach: A data breach the target appears in
entities.certificate: A TLS certificate and what it covers
entities.dns_record: A DNS record, such as an A, MX or TXT record
entities.image: An image, or a link to one
entities.document: A document or file, and its metadata
entities.other: Anything else a tool reports, described in its attributes

categories.images-geo: Images, reverse image search and geolocation
categories.web-archive: Archived web pages and URL history
categories.documents-metadata: Documents and the metadata in files
categories.utilities: Helpers: parsing, converting and generating values
